[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed to Rowan Green Data LLC, in Morrow County, Oregon, near Boardman. No source located this session confirms the identity or corporate background of Rowan Green Data LLC specifically; this style of limited liability company name is a pattern sometimes used by large technology companies to acquire land or file permits without immediately disclosing their identity, but that connection was not confirmed this session and should not be assumed. A Wikipedia fetch for Morrow County did confirm that in 2022 Amazon announced plans to build at least five commercial data centers in the county, an estimated 12 billion dollar investment, and that the county is also home to the Port of Morrow near Boardman on the Columbia River, which hosts the Coyote Springs I and II natural gas power plants, providing regional context for large scale data center development in this county even though it does not confirm the operator of this specific registry row. No building specific address, founding date, ownership, or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
